local_review.finding_body: The 6.1.7 metadata made the serializable AspectJMethodBeforeAdvice entry conditional on InstantiationModelAwarePointcutAdvisorImpl. On the CI GraalVM 25.0.4+7.1, that condition activates in Spring AOT applications where the advice type is not otherwise reachable and fails during image layout with `Type not found during analysis: ... AspectJMethodBeforeAdvice`. The exact defect previously caused PR #10119's Spring AOT matrix to fail and be reverted. Because the violation is in this contribution's own metadata, it is repaired under §FS-contribution-contract.5.1.
local_review.finding_title: Over-broad Spring AOP serialization condition breaks affected native consumers
local_review.fix_note: Changed only the AspectJMethodBeforeAdvice condition in metadata/org.springframework/spring-aop/6.1.7/reachability-metadata.json to ReflectiveAspectJAdvisorFactory, matching the narrower established 6.1.0 trigger. Verified the exact Spring AOT :batch:batch reproducer changes from failure to success and ran clean, pullAllowedDockerImages, checkMetadataFiles, test, and checkstyle for org.springframework:spring-aop:6.1.7 successfully.
local_review.review_comment: The required Spring AOT workflow failed 74 matrix jobs on head 43897a3c17d with the same Native Image layout error for AspectJMethodBeforeAdvice; upstream smoke jobs passed, and PR #10119 previously introduced and then reverted the same spring-aop 6.1.7 regression. I reproduced the failure in :batch:batch with the workflow's Spring AOT main checkout and GraalVM 25.0.4+7.1, then verified the repaired metadata makes that exact nativeCompile/nativeAppTest lane pass. The complete resulting contribution diff remains confined to org.springframework:spring-aop:6.1.7, keeps the advisor serialization test and all native execution enabled, and preserves overall and reflection dynamic-access coverage at 23/23 (100%), equal to 6.1.0. The coordinate-scoped metadata check, Checkstyle, JVM tests, Native Image build, and all 19 native tests pass on GraalVM 25.0.4+7.1.
